summary: Polish-phase E2E validation for OurRealm Game Creator: Fire Economy, Score idempotency, Claim flow, Controls & Input Modes, Diversity blocking, and Fire-info gating. Backend pytest suite (test_polish_phase.py, 12 tests) → 11 passed, 1 skipped (claim skipped because tftwo's collectable_balance was already 0 from prior main-agent verification run — an expected side effect, not a bug). Frontend verified via Playwright as founder stealth: /admin/games?game=d36d0d04... shows both game-controls-panel (with controls-toggle + controls-key-left/right + sliders + Left-handed/Haptic/Reduced motion/High contrast/Show control guide checkboxes + button position select) and game-fire-economy (with fire-econ-toggle + 1,000,000 pool stat cards + fire-econ-rw-completion=10 + fire-econ-preview reading 'avg player ~175 🔥 · max possible 200 🔥 · worst-case month 200 🔥 · supports 5,000 full completions · 100% of pool remaining. Rewards are validated, idempotent and land as claimable Fire'). /admin/games create panel has game-opt-supported-controls SELECT defaulting to 'Desktop + Mobile (default)'. /games?play=850b4ee4... (Crystal Caverns) renders game-fire-info banner '🔥 999,925 Fire available · Stage clear +10 · Finish +50 · Perfect +5 · Speed +5 · Achievements +5 · up to 195 🔥 per player · community pool 100% remaining', game-runtime-iframe with a humanoid platformer hero (small stick figure on ledge — NOT a rocket), game-leaderboard, game-audio-settings all present. /games?play=af6cab00... (Cyber Heist) renders top-down stealth operative with cyan light on left wall (NOT a rocket), red drones visible, game-fire-info + iframe + leaderboard present.
critical_code_review_comments: Response shape note for future testing agents: admin fire-economy uses economy.pool (not pool_remaining) and economy.pool_initial; public /api/games/{gid}/fire-info uses pool_remaining. Game version lives at /api/games/{gid} → game.version (not root .version). Estimate response wraps under 'estimate' key with plan.showcase_similarity {score, top_match, threshold, blocked}. Cancel estimate is POST /api/admin/games/estimate/{id}/cancel (not DELETE).

Diversity guard verified: 'space flight survival … salvage cores … asteroid mines' vs Galaxy Salvager scored 0.9 (top_match=Galaxy Salvager, threshold=0.75, blocked=true) and build returned 400 'Showcase Diversity Validation blocked this build: 90% structural overlap with "Galaxy Salvager". Change the runtime, control model or player representation and re-estimate.' Different prompt (memory matching card game) → blocked=false. Both estimates were cancelled — NO builds triggered.

Score idempotency verified end-to-end: identical submission (tftwo → Crystal Caverns, score 150, completed, time_s 250, stage 2) returns fire_rewards:[] on second POST; pool decrement equals granted amount exactly (0 in this run because tftwo's Crystal Caverns rewards were already granted in prior main-agent verification).

Controls guard: keyboard conflict {left:[a],right:[a]} → 400, both-disabled → 400, left_handed toggle bumps game.version. Fire-economy PATCH rewards & PATCH left_handed both bump game.version correctly.
Fire-info gating: PATCH paused:true toggles enabled=false on public endpoint; restored to paused:false after test.
seed_data_creation: Two estimates created via /api/admin/games/estimate (id captured, both cancelled via POST /cancel — no builds, no LLM cost beyond the estimate calls). Two extra score submissions on Crystal Caverns as tftwo (already at best_score 150, so idempotent — no new fire granted).
